title: qPCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the web interface above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload the custom labware files with .json extensions.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate the labware, tiprack, and pipette (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Prepare cDNA dilution and PCR
steps.instruction: Perform the custom cDNA dilution and set up a 384‑well PCR plate, preparing each reaction in triplicate as defined by the protocol.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the protocol.
